You may not move fewer than two cells, and you may not move backward. You must avoid moving onto any blue cells. On the eleventh turn, what is the 6-digit hex code (without prefix) of the color of the cell where you land after moving?

mistake_reason: At step 2, FileSurfer asserted with certainty that the workbook was loaded and provided specific sheet names, cell locations, obstacle ranges, and color hex values despite not actually accessing or reading the attached file. This is an FM-4.1 hallucination: fabricating detailed, technical facts (e.g., sheet 'MapGrid', START at C3, blue clusters, color codes like 2E83F2) without any grounding in tools or data. Subsequent path simulation and the final color answer (5CB1F0) relied on these fabricated details, leading to an incorrect result.
